text:
ravi: Heads up team  I'll be in Austin next week, staying near South Congress. Looking for quick dinner recs for ~8 people on Thu around 7pm. BBQ vs tacos vs pizza? Not super fancy, just good & communal. Any local go-tos?

ela: Franklin is legendary for BBQ but thats a long wait and early lines. For groups, Micklethwait Craft Meats is more casual and better for sitting together.

matt: For tacos, Torchy's is reliable and fast but a chain. For more local vibes, Veracruz All Natural has killer migas tacos and a faster line.

sophie: If you want walkable options on South Congress, Home Slice is great for pizza and big pies for sharing.

ravi: Perfect. Trying to balance speed and seating for 8. Any place that reliably takes a group that size without reservations?

ela: Micklethwait can handle a group but it's picnic-style; bring cash for sides sometimes. Home Slice takes reservations for large groups if you call ahead. Veracruz is walk-up and fast but could split the group.

matt: Quick poll: :meat_on_bone: Micklethwait (BBQ), :taco: Veracruz (tacos), :pizza: Home Slice (pizza), :chain: Torchy's (fast, casual)

sophie: :pizza:

emma: :taco: (if i may vote; not on participants list but passing by)

ravi: Leaning Home Slice since we can reserve a table for 8 and everyone seems to like pizza. Does anyone want to meet earlier for drinks on Congress Ave?

ela: I'm in for 6:30 drinks at Jo's Coffee patio if the weather's nice.

matt: Works for me. Locking Home Slice 19:00 Thu for 8 unless objections.

ops-bot: calendar: Event created "South Congress Dinner  Ravi + team" Thu 19:00-20:30 provisional. Attendees: ravi, ela, matt, sophie.

matt: If anyone needs to cancel/reschedule, DM me and I'll update the res.
avi: Awesome, appreciate the quick recs and the help locking it in. Excited to try Home Slice with y'all!
